validation.countInterpretation: Counts here are based on block labels printed in Version 10, including the November 3 remote-learning A day. The prior Version 7 verified ground truth excluded April 1–2; that prior interpretation has been preserved separately and should not be assumed to match Version 10.

icsDesign.instructionalDayEvent: one timed event per instructional/scheduled school day, spanning the first scheduled period start through the last scheduled period end for that day's bell schedule
icsDesign.nonInstructionalDayEvent: one all-day event for holidays, recesses, no-student days, professional-development/rating days, and other calendar-wide non-instructional events
icsDesign.specialScheduleWithoutBellMapping: all-day source-calendar event; no invented bell times
icsDesign.regents: individual timed exam events using times printed in the school-year calendar; no regular instructional periods
icsDesign.parentTeacher: daily scheduled block uses the PTC bell schedule when mapped; the source-calendar PT afternoon/evening item remains a separate timed event
icsDesign.administrativeDistribution: one daily timed event spanning Period 1 through Period 10; the Distribution interval is described in the event but does not create a separate period event
